description: This file provides utility functions for streaming tests within the Orleans framework, including logging, stream pub/sub retrieval, and assertions for testing stream counts.

classes.name: StreamTestUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for logging, stream pub/sub access, and assertions used in streaming tests.

methods.name: LogStartTest
methods.description: Logs the start of a test, including silo and stream details.

methods.name: LogEndTest
methods.description: Logs the end of a test.

methods.name: GetStreamPubSub
methods.description: Retrieves the pub/sub instance for a given cluster client.

methods.name: CheckPubSubCounts
methods.description: Checks and asserts the expected number of publishers and consumers for a stream.

methods.name: Assert_AreEqual
methods.description: Asserts that two integers are equal, with optional logging and skipping when expected is -1.
